provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized bicycle at m=127, a prime with ord_2(m)=7, so the nontrivial cyclotomic cosets of 2 all have size 7. The divisor g is a product of the minimal polynomials of 6 cyclotomic cosets of size 7, times x+1, of degree 43, which fixes k = 2 deg g = 86 by construction. The pair (a,b) was then drawn from the ideal (g) by information-set decoding over sparse supports, keeping weights 14 and 14. Both weights are even, so x+1 divides the gcd; m is prime, so the only block logical this forces has weight m and is far above the claim. H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)] and H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T] on n = 2m = 254 qubits at uniform row weight 28, with a = [4, 5, 21, 34, 43, 46, 49, 52, 56, 78, 79, 86, 90, 115] and b = [24, 34, 47, 49, 53, 54, 61, 63, 67, 70, 99, 111, 119, 123].
provenance.notes: Distance is an upper bound from the lighter of two witnesses, weight 18 on X and 18 on Z, both carried in this file. A 24-seed randomized information-set search at 2,000,000 trials per seed read 18 on every seed. A single run of 8,000,000 trials, matching the verifier's own depth, reads 18. A search restricted to logicals supported inside one circulant block, which a general search is blind to, found nothing below 21. Folding onto the x^t-invariant subspaces leaves a lightest surviving logical of weight 62. The design point is deg g / m = 0.339.
